easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature token.
You control another creature.
description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.
